panel.name: panel_local_spawned
panel.string: No copies in world yet. Rez a mesh from the Mesh tab.

button.name: select_btn
button.label: Select in World
button.tool_tip: Select this copy and open the Build floater to edit it (does not move the camera).

button.name: focus_btn
button.label: Focus Camera
button.tool_tip: Point the camera at this copy.

button.name: derez_btn
button.label: Derez
button.tool_tip: Remove the selected copy (or copies) from the world.

button.name: derez_all_btn
button.label: Derez All
button.tool_tip: Remove every rezzed copy from the world.
